Privacy policy

Last updated 30 Oct 2026

This policy explains what information Peptide Chooser ("we") collects when you visit peptidechooser.com and how we use it.

Information we collect

  • Email you send us. If you contact us, we receive your email address and whatever you include in your message. We use it only to reply.
  • Server logs. Our hosting provider (GitHub Pages) may record technical data such as IP address, browser type and the pages requested, for security and to operate the service. We do not use this data to identify you.
  • Analytics, only if you accept. We use Google Analytics 4 to count visits and see which pages people find useful. It runs only after you press "Accept" on the cookie notice. If you press "Reject", no analytics cookie is set and nothing is sent to Google. Google processes this data under its own privacy policy. We do not use advertising trackers, and we do not sell or share visitor data.

Cookies

The site sets one small value in your browser to remember your cookie choice. Google Analytics sets its own cookies (named _ga and similar) only after you accept. You can change your mind by clearing the site's data in your browser; the notice will then appear again.

Paid links

When you click a paid link, you leave our site. The seller or affiliate network may set cookies to record that you came from us. Their own privacy policies apply to that data.

How long we keep information

We keep email correspondence for as long as needed to answer you and to keep a record of corrections, and no longer than 24 months unless the law requires otherwise.

Your rights

You can ask us to see, correct or delete the personal information we hold about you. Residents of the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom and some U.S. states, including California, have additional rights under their local laws. Email hello@peptidechooser.com and we will respond within 30 days.

Children

This site is intended for adults. We do not knowingly collect information from anyone under 18.

Contact
